entries.intro: Just a small update, nothing too special. I'm planning to work on a performance improvement for the app. I'm not sure whether it's possible, but it's worth a try. The next release will tell us whether it worked, lol. I've been busy recently, so you can expect commits to be pushed more slowly. PRs that improve the app experience are more than welcome!

items: Updated Better Lyrics (New Engine) to commit `8c2f405`

sections.title: ✨ New Features & UI
items: Updated some dependencies. For more details, see [this commit](https://github.com/NanKillBro/glassy-music-nankill/commit/21e95914107f2d60f73c70622dbb4dd92969e060).

footnotes: **(1)** These changes were not made by me. I picked them from [michei69/pear-desktop](https://github.com/michei69/pear-desktop). Thank you so much!

entries.intro: 🎉 **Thank you guys so much for 300 stars!** This means a lot to me! GitHub says it's already been two months since my last release, so here's a new version!

sections.title: 🔄 Updates
items: Updated Better Lyrics (New Engine) to version `3.0.0.2` ^(4)
Backported some compatible fixes and features from the New Engine to Better Lyrics (Old Engine).
Updated Better Lyrics Shaders to version `1.5.0`

sections.title: ✨ New Features & UI
items: Added the crossfade plugin, which now works properly.
You can now change Better Lyrics Shaders settings while using the Better Lyrics theme.
Added a new splash screen when opening the app, kind of like Discord's.
Added a button to download the currently playing track in its original quality.
Improved performance in a few areas. ^(1)
Some new features from the Better Lyrics and Better Lyrics Shaders updates aren't listed here.

sections.title: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Fixed solid colors in the new player, which may be part of an A/B test. ^(3)
Fixed an issue that prevented opening the Better Lyrics (New Engine) options.
Fixed some issues with the Better Lyrics theme editor.
Fixed the search tab being misaligned. ^(3)
Fixed song info becoming offset in crossfade after using fullscreen lyrics without fullscreen.
Fixed the fullscreen bottom-hover behavior: hovering at the bottom now shows the player bar as usual.

sections.title: 📜 Other Changes
items: Changed the sublabels for the Better Lyrics (Old Engine) and Better Lyrics (New Engine) options.
Changed the app ID from `glassy-music-nankill-mod` to `glassy-music-nankill`. ^(2)

footnotes: **(1)** The smooth progress bar is disabled by default because it caused frequent layout recalculations. The in-app menu was also improved ([pear-desktop PR #4671](https://github.com/pear-devs/pear-desktop/pull/4671)), and only the active language is now loaded at startup ([pear-desktop PR #4674](https://github.com/pear-devs/pear-desktop/pull/4674)).
**(2)** This change may break some existing installations, so you may need to uninstall the app before updating to this version.
**(3)** YTM changed something that broke these things, and this update fixes them.
**(4)** It still has some UI bugs. I'll fix them in the next release.

entries.intro: 🎉 **Thank you guys so much for 200 stars!** This means a lot to me. No idea why my project has that many stars recently, but I decided to re-version the release so that future versions follow Semantic Versioning. So yeah, v4.0.0 is here guys! This update is bigger than normal.

sections.title: ✨ New Features & UI
items: Added new plugin: Better Lyrics Tacet ^(1), Pitch Shift
Added new scroll type: GlassyFlow Turbo ^(2)
Player speed plugin now has an option to change pitch
New UI for the Play Together popup
New UI for the top bar icon row
Better Lyrics now has 2 engine options: New Engine (still in development) and Old Engine (default). Allows you to change the scroll animation.

sections.title: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Fixed nav bar have solid color. [#14](https://github.com/NanKillBro/glassy-music-nankill/issues/14) ^(3)
Fixed invisible arrow in Better Lyrics settings.
Fixed Toggling the Navigation plugin multiple times will spawn multiple controls. [#12](https://github.com/NanKillBro/glassy-music-nankill/issues/12)
Fixed Song/Video misaligned to the right ^(3)

sections.title: 📜 Other Changes
items: Merge Theme no longer has a version.
Hovering over lyrics no longer makes them brighter, but scrolling still works.
Hovering at the bottom in fullscreen no longer makes the control bar appear; you now need to hover over the Better Lyrics Dock. ^(4)
"Instrumental Only" lyrics will now be hidden.
Moved font settings into the Better Lyrics plugin menu.
"Fullscreen lyrics without fullscreen" button now also shows up in the top bar row.
GlassyFlow no longer occasionally keeps past lyrics showing.

footnotes: **(1)** Tacet is still experimental. You can use it for crossfade only if you want, but for separating voices, it may or may not work and can cause performance issues or freeze the app. Currently, only Windows supports using the GPU to separate voices. On Linux, it may use the CPU since the GPU doesn't work for some reason.
**(2)** YTM recently changed something that made the app really laggy. This is my best attempt to improve performance against it, though some performance issues remain.
**(3)** YTM changed something that broke things, and this update fixes it.
**(4)** YouTube broke something, so I decided to turn the bug into a feature, lol.
